title: Making Plans & Invitations
grammarNotes: 'Ir a' + infinitive ('voy a quedarme,' 'vamos a cenar') is the everyday way to talk about near-future plans — much more common in speech than the future tense you may have seen in textbooks.

'Quedar' here means 'to arrange to meet' ('¿quedamos el viernes?'), a different sense from 'quedar' meaning 'to remain' or 'to fit' (you'll see that second sense in the Shopping unit) — context tells you which one is meant.
Declining an invitation politely almost always softens the 'no': 'lo siento, no puedo' or 'tal vez otro día' rather than a blunt refusal.

phrases.en: Do you feel like going to the movies?
Do you want to come to the party?

phrases.es: ¿Por qué no vamos a la playa?
phrases.en: Why don't we go to the beach?

phrases.es: De acuerdo, nos vemos a las ocho

phrases.en: What are you going to do on Saturday?
We can see each other later
Do you have plans for tonight?
We'll sort it out by message

phrases.es: Mejor lo dejamos para otro día
phrases.en: Let's leave it for another day

sentences.es: ¿Quieres que quedemos el sábado por la tarde?
sentences.en: Do you want us to meet Saturday afternoon?

sentences.es: ¿Le gustaría acompañarnos a cenar el jueves?
sentences.en: Would you like to join us for dinner Thursday?

sentences.es: Vamos a ir al concierto, ¿te animas?
sentences.en: We're going to the concert, are you up for it?

sentences.es: Estoy ocupada esta semana, pero podríamos vernos la próxima.
sentences.en: I'm busy this week, but we could see each other next week.

sentences.es: Señora Ibarra, ¿tendría tiempo para una reunión el lunes?
sentences.en: Mrs. Ibarra, would you have time for a meeting on Monday?

sentences.es: Oye, ¿qué vas a hacer después del trabajo?
sentences.en: Hey, what are you going to do after work?

sentences.es: Prefiero quedar en un lugar tranquilo, si no te importa.
sentences.en: I'd rather meet somewhere quiet, if you don't mind.

sentences.es: Le propongo que nos veamos a las cinco, si le viene bien.
sentences.en: I propose we meet at five, if that works for you.

sentences.es: No puedo el viernes, pero el domingo estoy libre.
sentences.en: I can't on Friday, but I'm free on Sunday.

sentences.es: ¿Podría confirmarme si asistirá a la cena?
sentences.en: Could you confirm for me whether you'll attend the dinner?

sentences.es: Vamos a intentar quedar antes de que te vayas de viaje.
sentences.en: Let's try to meet up before you leave on your trip.

sentences.es: Si está usted disponible, podríamos reunirnos la próxima semana.
sentences.en: If you're available, we could get together next week.

sentences.es: Todavía no sé qué voy a hacer, te aviso luego.
sentences.en: I still don't know what I'm going to do, I'll let you know later.

sentences.es: Nos encantaría invitarlo a la boda, señor Reyes.
sentences.en: We'd love to invite you to the wedding, Mr. Reyes.

sentences.es: Mejor cancelemos, va a llover todo el fin de semana.
sentences.en: Let's cancel instead, it's going to rain all weekend.

dialogue.speaker: lucía
dialogue.es: Oye, pues... ¿te apetece que quedemos este finde?
dialogue.en: Hey, well... do you feel like getting together this weekend?

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.es: Uy, no sé, o sea, tengo bastante trabajo, ¿verdad que el sábado es feriado?
dialogue.en: Oh, I don't know, I mean, I have a lot of work — isn't Saturday a holiday though?

dialogue.speaker: lucía
dialogue.es: Bueno, sí, por eso te digo, podríamos ir a comer algo tranquilo.
dialogue.en: Well, yeah, that's why I'm asking — we could go grab something low-key to eat.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.es: Ah, va, entonces sí, o sea, cuenta conmigo.
dialogue.en: Ah, okay then, yes — I mean, count me in.

dialogue.speaker: lucía
dialogue.es: Perfecto, ¿te paso a buscar a la una o prefieres que quedemos allá?
dialogue.en: Perfect, should I pick you up at one, or do you prefer we meet there?

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.es: Mejor quedamos allá, así aprovecho y hago unas vueltas antes.
dialogue.en: Let's meet there instead, that way I can run some errands before.
